name: smwmusic-the-thing-main-theme
title: The Thing - Main Theme
description:
This is an arrangement of the main theme from John Carpenter's movie "The Thing". This song is ominous and creepy and would probably fit a lot of level themes.

This piece was originally ported for the multiple Puzzle/Escape Room sections in Grand Poo World 2.

*Note that the Global Volume is set as high as it can go without the there being any static or feedback. It is not intended to be used at this volume necessarily, I just wanted to be sure no one used it any louder than this.
